description: For every arithmetic formula \(A(\bar z,x)\) and every fixed finite tuple \(\bar p\in\mathbb N^k\), including the empty tuple, there is no equivalence \(\mathbb N\models A(\bar p,\overline{\ulcorner\sigma\urcorner})\leftrightarrow\mathbb N\models\sigma\) holding for every arithmetic sentence \(\sigma\).
